title: A receipt you tear off
summary: Drag the receipt away slowly for a clean tear, or fast for a jagged edge.

prompts.text: Make a web page with a paper receipt that I can tear off with the mouse or a finger. If I drag it away slowly, it tears along a clean, even line. If I drag it away fast, the edge comes out jagged and uneven. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, open it in my browser when it is done, and ask me before you install anything.
prompts.label: A receipt that tears clean or jagged

action.label: Make a receipt you can tear
